test_title: PYST 58: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Cannot be corrected
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**incorrigible**" means "cannot be corrected," which fits the context of the question perfectly.

Hence, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Example sentence**: An incorrigible behavior cannot be corrected despite multiple efforts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Illegible means unreadable, which is unrelated to being corrected.
 
• **Option 3:** Incredible denotes something unbelievable and does not align with the context of correction.
 
• **Option 4:** Ineligible refers to disqualification or not meeting criteria, which is irrelevant here.
